annotation_definition: Pump/connected motor or explicitly transferable technical evidence. Exclude contents, drawings/parts lists, warranty, general management and unrelated equipment. Condition includes numeric/temporal applicability. Negation requires an explicit prohibition/negated predicate, not a fault name such as 'no power'. Alternative means substitute inspection/remedial actions, not ordinary lists of causes/parts/brands. Compound action requires two actions with order, dependency or joint prerequisites, not unrelated bullet lists.
